newsitem.title: USA: Air-Cure agrees to buy Ohmstede for $50mln.
newsitem.headline: Air-Cure agrees to buy Ohmstede for $50mln.

text.p: Air-Cure Technologies Inc said on Friday it had a definitive agreement to buy tube heat exchanger manufacturer Ohmstede Inc for $50 million.
The previously-announced acquisition would be financed by a private placement and funding from Air-Cure's bank credit facilities, the company said in a statement.
Air-Cure Chief Financial Officer Larry McAfee said in a statement the acquisition was expected to close in October and should contribute to earnings immediately.
The company refused to comment on the size of any potential contibution to earnings.
Ohmstede is the largest manufacturer of shell and tube heat exchangers in the United States, Air-Cure said.
It had five plants located along the Gulf Coast.
